name: gromacs-tool
description: GROMACS 2025.3 tool for molecular dynamics simulations, structure preparation, and trajectory analysis, with CPU execution, Open MPI 4.1.6, and OpenMP — packaged for the PSC environment.

code_environments.description:
Bash code environment with GROMACS 2025.3 for CPU molecular dynamics,
structure preparation, and trajectory analysis.

Available commands:

- gmx_mpi: GROMACS preprocessing, simulation, and analysis commands
- mpirun / mpiexec: Launch external MPI processes with Open MPI 4.1.6
- bash: Shell scripting and simulation workflow orchestration
- cp: Copy input files and package calculation results

Can handle:

- Structure preparation and topology generation with pdb2gmx
- Solvation, box setup, and ion placement
- Run-input preparation with grompp
- Energy minimization and NVE, NVT, and NPT molecular dynamics
- Parallel CPU simulations using MPI ranks and OpenMP threads
- Simulation checkpoint continuation
- Trajectory conversion and analysis
- Energy, RMSD, RMSF, hydrogen-bond, and other supported analyses
- Simulation workflow execution, logging, and result packaging

MPI EXAMPLE:

mpirun -np 4 gmx_mpi mdrun -s /app/inputs/topol.tpr -deffnm md -ntomp 1

Select MPI ranks with mpirun -np and OpenMP threads per rank with -ntomp.
Keep ranks multiplied by threads per rank within the CPUs allocated to
the worker. This image uses external MPI; do not pass -ntmpi or -nt.
All MPI ranks run inside the single worker container.

FORCE FIELDS:

Use installed force-field names such as oplsaa, amber99sb-ildn,
charmm27, or gromos54a7. For example: pdb2gmx -ff oplsaa -water tip4p.

WATER COORDINATES:

For TIP4P, use /opt/gromacs/share/gromacs/top/tip4p.gro with a compatible
tip4p.itp topology. TIP4P has four coordinate sites per water molecule.
spc216.gro contains three-site waters and is not a TIP4P coordinate file.
gmx_mpi solvate -p topol.top can update the SOL molecule count directly.

IMPORTANT PATHS:

- /app/inputs: Input structure and data files mounted by PSC (read-only)
- /work: Working directory and output directory captured by Discovery
- /opt/gromacs/bin/gmx_mpi: Installed GROMACS executable
- /opt/gromacs/share/gromacs/top: Installed force fields and topology data

Read inputs from /app/inputs and write calculation files in /work.
When invoking this code environment, set outputMounts to ["/work"].
Discovery captures files from /work directly, including logs.out.
The launcher preserves the script's exit status. No output_directory
parameter is required, and results are not copied back onto themselves.
